mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if exported for foreign use; not required domestically)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of natural-person UBO passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the UBO's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if the country is not an apostate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for UBO and manager (recent utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or bank in said jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Negative criminal record excerpt / good conduct certificate for proposed managers and directors

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC SDN, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List and Luxembourg domestic counter-terrorism screening of all shareholders, UBOs, managers and authorized signatories. Screening must occur prior to incorporation and in real-time thereafter. Enhanced due diligence applies when any individual qualifies as a politically exposed person (PEP), family member, or close associate under FATF and CSSF requirements. A written compliance certification and system-generated audit trail are mandatory prerequisites to the LLM transaction.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) via www.lbr.lu / www.lb.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin script and shall comply with the administrative languages of Luxembourg (French, German, Luxembourgish). A name in a foreign language may be accepted provided it is transliterated into Latin characters and does not conflict with existing registered names, public order or morality. A SARL must use either the full phrase 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or the abbreviation 'SARL' as a suffix or prefix to its operational name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon notification of rejection by the LBR or the RCS, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Ministry of Justice within three months of notification. The appeal must state the legal grounds and attach all supporting refusal documents. The administrative authority may grant an extension of the original name reservation for an additional 60 days if the request is submitted before the reservation expiry and is based on objectively pending formalities. A court appeal is available before the Tribunal administratif and subsequently the Cour administrative in accordance with the Law of 11 July 2013 on administrative procedure.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office without any physical presence is not permissible for a Luxembourg SARL. The registered office must be situated at a physical address in Luxembourg. Dedicated domiciliation agents and serviced offices are commonly accepted, and for an ISIC 9000 digital webtoon publishing company such a structure may be sufficient. However, anti-abuse / BEPS substance requirements require the entity to maintain adequate human resources and management functions at the Luxembourg address. The domiciliation arrangement must be evidenced by a signed service agreement and declare the real business activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of approximately 10–15% annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the RCS, CSSF or the Luxembourg tax authorities, under current substance verification programmes. The likelihood is mitigated by the low AML risk tier of the digital webtoon publishing industry, provided all UBO, accounting and minute records are physically accessible at the registered office.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (notably by the Law of 19 August 2016 and the Law of 7 April 2021); Articles 710-1 to 710-25 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée); Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 27 November 2017 on RCS electronic filings.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés – RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), under the supervision of the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation containing the Articles of Association (statuts constitutifs), e-filed with the RCS and published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SARL is formed with a fully subscribed minimum share capital of EUR 12,000. At incorporation, at least 25% of the nominal value of each share subscribed in cash must be liberated and deposited into a blocked subscription account at a Luxembourg credit institution; the balance is payable on call. Contributions in kind must be fully transferred within five years of incorporation. The bank blocked-funds certificate is annexed to the notarial deed; funds are released only after the notary gives authority in view of RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby ratify the subscription of 100 shares of EUR 120.00 each, constituting the entire subscribed capital of EUR 12,000, and confirm receipt of the bank blocked-capital certificate issued by [Bank]. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is established at 12 Rue de Strasbourg, L-2561 Luxembourg, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, as announced in the Articles of Association. FURTHER RESOLVED, that Ms./Mr. [Name], residing at [Address], is appointed as Manager (Gérant) with sole signature power, and is authorized to file the incorporation deed with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register, to arrange RESA publication, and to attend to all post-incorporation formalities. THIS RESOLUTION is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Clearance and Pre-Incorporation File Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) via the instructing Luxembourg civil-law notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary to search the RCS name database to confirm that the proposed corporate name is distinguishable and not misleading. Fix the corporate name, registered office, corporate object (digital webtoon publishing and multilingual chapter syndication), share allocation, and the intended manager (gérant) in a draft of the articles of association. Circulate the draft for shareholder approval before the signing appointment.
required_dossiers: Three proposed corporate names in order of preference
Passport copies of all subscribers and the intended manager
Draft articles of association
Power of attorney if any founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS flags confusing similarity, the notary submits an alternative name or adds a distinctive element and re-runs the clearance before notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital and Blocked-Account Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (e.g., Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État – Spuerkeess, BGL BNP Paribas, or Banque Internationale à Luxembourg).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary subscription account in the name of the company in formation. Transfer the fully subscribed capital of EUR 12,000 (or such higher amount as the shareholders agree). Obtain the bank's blocked-funds certificate (attestation de blocage) confirming that the deposit is held pending release under the notary's authority. Deliver the certificate to the notary for annexation to the deed.
required_dossiers: Company-in-formation questionnaire (bank form)
AML/KYC forms for all ultimate beneficial owners
Passport or national ID copies
Proof of address and source of funds
Corporate authorization of any shareholder that is a legal entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises a query on source of funds, provide enhanced documentary evidence (bank statements, transaction trail, asset history) and re-submit the blocked-capital file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Notarial Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg civil-law notary (Notaire) belonging to the Chamber of Notaries (Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend the signing appointment before the notary. The notary verifies the identity and capacity of the parties, the legality of the corporate object, the bank blocked-funds certificate, and the registered-office lease. The deed is read, signed, and certified. The notary retains the original minute and provides certified copies for the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Draft notarial deed (statuts)
Bank blocked-funds certificate
Commercial lease agreement for the registered office or proof of domiciliation
Passport copies of the founders and the manager
AML declarations completed under the notary's procedure
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests amendments (e.g., to the object clause or the manager's powers), execute an amended deed or an explanatory addendum before signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the RCS and Acquisition of Legal Personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary e-files the incorporation deed and the standard registration form with the RCS immediately after signature. The RCS verifies the file and issues the registration number (B-number). Upon registration, the company acquires legal personality. The manager requests the certified RCS extract (extrait du registre). Beneficial-owner details are filed in the Register of Beneficial Owners within one month, separate from the RCS dossier.
required_dossiers: Notarial deed of incorporation
RCS registration form (standard form)
Declaration of beneficial owners (UBO) under the Law of 13 January 2019
Identification of the correspondent or legal representative for filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS queries the file, cure the deficiency with a supplementary notarial act or a corrected form. In case of refusal, appeal to the District Court of Luxembourg (Tribunal d'arrondissement) within statutory deadlines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RESA Publication and Post-Incorporation Tax and E-Commerce Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RESA electronic gazette); Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Commission nationale pour la protection des données (CNPD).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The RCS publishes the incorporation extract in RESA. Concurrently, the manager registers the company for VAT with the AEDT using the RCS number, files the corporate income tax and municipal business tax registration with the ACD, and, if processing readers' personal data, declares the data-processing register with the CNPD. If staff are hired, register as an employer with the Joint Social Security Centre (CCSS) and with the Inspectorate of Labour and Mines (ITM).
required_dossiers: Certified RCS extract
Articles of association (clean copy)
Manager's identity document
Registered-office confirmation
VAT application form (immatriculation à la TVA)
E-commerce platform agreements (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing) for fiscal documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registrations are delayed, file an informal request for assessment (demande en imposition) with the ACD and request an accelerated VAT number by written application to the AEDT.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie – Direction générale de l'industrie, des nouvelles technologies et de la recherche (not applicable: the activity is a non-regulated digital service).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (business establishment permit) – not required: webtoon syndication and digital publishing are non-regulated activities under the Law of 2 September 2011 on access to the professions of craftsman, trader, industrialist and certain liberal professions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Luxembourg Environmental Protection Administration), under the Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt. No full environmental impact assessment, environmental statement, or registration dossier is required under the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment because the project is a purely digital publishing activity with no physical installation, no land take, and no emission source.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the digital activity. Limited compliance applies to the registered office: municipal wastewater discharge ordinance; waste segregation under the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste management, including separate collection of electronic waste pursuant to Directive 2012/19/EU (WEEE); where EU cloud/data-center services are procured, preference for ISO 14001 or EMAS-certified providers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety conformity: certificate of compliance (certificat de sécurité incendie) issued by the municipal fire-prevention authority for the occupied premises. Structural soundness: landlord's certificate of habitability and load-resistance annexed to the lease. Occupational clearance: registration with the Inspectorate of Labour and Mines (ITM) as an employer, compliance with Labour Code provisions on visual-display-unit workstations, and, if physical archives or server equipment are stored, municipal building clearance under the code of civil safety.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration (Administration des Contributions Directes - ACD); Luxembourg Indirect Tax and VAT Administration (Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA - AEDT); corporate registration through Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR / RCS); unified digital entry point: MyGuichet.lu professional eSpace (eTVA portal for VAT).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must (1) register the LU SARL with the RCS via LBR to obtain the corporate registration number (matricule); (2) obtain the direct-tax NIF automatically aligned to the matricule from the ACD; and (3) obtain the Luxembourg VAT identification number (LU + 8 digits) from the AEDT through the MyGuichet/eTVA portal using the standard VAT registration application, or through the EU One-Stop-Shop (OSS) for intra-EU B2C digital supplies. Non-EU suppliers without a Luxembourg establishment must appoint an AEDT-approved VAT representative unless OSS is used. Required exhibits include apostilled articles of association, proof of substance (office, director mandates), and the Webtoon commercialization contracts with Apple IAP and Google Play Billing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - an LU SARL is a per se opaque resident company subject to corporate income tax (17%) plus municipal business tax (up to 6.75%) plus the solidarity surcharge (7% of CIT), giving an aggregate rate of about 24.94% (Luxembourg City), taxable on worldwide profits with relief through treaties, the participation exemption, and foreign PE exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box: SARL tax classification is statutory and cannot be elected. Available statutory elections: (i) VAT group treatment (assujetti unique - Art. 60 VAT Law); (ii) CIT fiscal unity/consolidation (integration fiscale - Art. 164bis ITL) for at least 95%-owned resident subsidiaries, binding for 5 years; (iii) application of the participation-exemption regime (Art. 166 ITL) for qualifying shareholdings; (iv) OSS registration for cross-border B2C digital supplies. Hybrid-mismatch neutralization rules (ATAD 2, in force 1 January 2020) apply automatically and are not elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / TVA) under the amended Luxembourg Law of 12 February 1979 and EU Council Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Zero registration threshold for non-established foreign suppliers - any taxable Luxembourg supply triggers registration. Domestic small-enterprise franchise exemption: EUR 35,000 annual turnover (with option to tax). Pan-EU threshold: EUR 10,000 for intra-EU distance sales and electronically supplied services to consumers, above which OSS registration and the destination-state VAT rate apply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory domestic B2B e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance/API stamping is in force as of the dossier reference date. B2G e-invoicing through PEPPOL (EN 16931) is mandatory for public contractors. Luxembourg is transposing the EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) package and has tabled draft legislation to introduce structured e-invoicing for domestic B2B supplies on a phased basis from 2026-2028; until then, optional e-invoicing with ex-post VAT returns filed through the AEDT eTVA/MyGuichet portal applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported outside the EU qualify for the 0% rate if the supplier holds proof of departure from the EU within the statutory periods (Art. 55 VAT Law). Digital Webtoon subscriptions are electronically supplied services: B2B supplies are outside Luxembourg VAT by reverse charge; B2C supplies to non-EU consumers are outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT (place of supply is the consumer residence) and may be presented as 0% / no LU VAT; B2C supplies to EU consumers are taxed under OSS at the destination-state rate (Luxembourg rates for domestic consumers: 17% standard, 8% reduced, 3% super-reduced for qualifying e-publications such as digital comics). No Luxembourg statutory FX-repatriation deadline exists; the 180-day benchmark is used for documentary and banking evidence of export proceeds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (SAD / EU export declaration with MRN) for physical goods
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR consignment note evidencing exit from EU territory
Commercial invoice, license and chapter-unlocking statements for the Webtoon content
Bank SWIFT / inward remittance certificate evidencing settlement of the export proceeds
For digital services: customer residence logs (IP geolocation, billing address), Apple IAP / Google Play Billing payment-rail reports, and OSS recapitulative statements
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Failure to substantiate zero-rating allows the AEDT to assess the VAT at 17% (or the applicable rate), with default interest of 0.6% per commenced month, administrative fines of EUR 250-7,500 per infraction (Art. 65 VAT Law), and a 10% surcharge on ex officio assessments. Fraudulent claims trigger criminal liability (Criminal Code sanctions) and extend the recovery limitation period from 5 to 10 years. The administration may retrospectively claw back input VAT credits and deny treaty or participation-exemption benefits where the SARL lacks economic substance (employees, premises, bank accounts) in Luxembourg.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque Centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting within the Eurosystem framework, with prudential and market-conduct coordination provided by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) in respect of licensed banks, payment institutions, and electronic money institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is the lawful currency and is fully convertible in Luxembourg for both current transactions and capital movements. Luxembourg maintains no exchange controls under EU law, and both residents and non-residents are free to hold, transfer, and invoice in EUR or any other currency. Capital account transactions, including shareholder contributions, intercompany loans, and purchase of foreign IP, do not require BCL or CSSF authorisation unless the underlying activity is in a regulated financial sector. Current account convertibility is unrestricted for service export payments, including digital webtoon platform royalties and app-store settlements. Profit remittance hurdles are not exchange-based but legal and fiscal: the SARL may distribute dividends only if its net assets exceed the subscribed and paid-up capital plus non-distributable reserves, and Luxembourg branch/tax formalities apply. Dividends paid by a Luxembourg SARL to a non-resident corporate shareholder are generally exempt from Luxembourg dividend withholding tax under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if a 10% participation or acquisition-cost threshold is met; otherwise a domestic 15% withholding tax arises, often reduced by an applicable double tax treaty. For non-resident individual shareholders, the 15% withholding tax is retained, subject to treaty relief.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Luxembourg imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no statutory conversion timeline, and no minimum conversion ratio for foreign currency earnings. A Luxembourg SARL may retain 100% of its export and licensing revenue denominated in EUR, USD, KRW, JPY, or other currencies in domestic or foreign accounts without BCL approval. For balance-of-payments statistics, resident companies are obliged to report certain cross-border services and direct investment flows to BCL under Luxembourg statistical law; digital webtoon publishing proceeds and app-store syndication receipts should be reported as 'other commercial services' when thresholds are met. No customs invoice or foreign exchange certificate is required for electronic delivery of digital comics. The company must keep ordinary commercial, accounting, and VAT documentation to substantiate the export nature of transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.profits_remittance_hurdle_analysis: Luxembourg company law blocks any dividend distribution that would reduce the net assets below the subscribed capital and reserves. The Board of Managers must prepare an inventory and verify distributable profits at the date of distribution. A documented formal shareholder resolution and financial statements from the statutory auditor are required where a statutory audit is obligatory. Exchange controls do not impede remittance, but banks require a tax residency certificate, a form 990/100 extract or corporate tax clearance when the recipient is a non-resident, and an application for withholding tax relief before the payment, if treaty benefits are claimed. In practice, the bank may require an executed dividend payment certificate and an affidavit from the receiving entity confirming its tax residence and proportionality of income received.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational current account in EUR and multi-currency, plus a segregated capital escrow sub-account for initial share capital deposit
Operational current account with treasury management, IBAN clearing in EUR, and SEPA/Cross-currency rail access

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État, Luxembourg (BCEE)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational current account and cash deposit account for working capital and liquidity buffers
Operational current account and trade settlement account; ancillary account for platform payout collection via SWIFT
Operational current account and treasury account for cross-border corporate finance and hedging documentation

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low for unregulated offshore digital EMIs and Low for using them as the sole treasury rail. A Luxembourg or EEA-passported electronic money institution licensed under PSD2 and supervised by CSSF or another EU authority may legally provide a payment account for the SARL, but its operational viability is constrained by transaction limits, lack of in-person banking services, no credit lines, and potential unwillingness of Luxembourg correspondent banks to accept third-party EMI settlements. Non-EEA, non-passported EMIs are effectively prohibited as primary operating banks because they cannot subscribe to the Luxembourg SEPA Clearing, do not have direct BCL settlement access, create AML/CRS implications, and are rejected by domestic banks that need to know the source of funds. For the webtoon and app-IAP treasury model, an EMI may be used only as a secondary collection node for small platform payouts, with all material balances moved immediately to a tier-1 Luxembourg bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory manager (Gérant) and all ultimate beneficial owners holding more than 25% must be identified and verified before account activation. Luxembourg AML legislation and CSSF circulars require the bank to establish an adequate customer due-diligence file and do not impose a blanket physical-presence rule for corporate accounts. In practice, tier-1 banks require at least one physical appearance by the managing director or a fully instructed representative for signature verification, or in alternation, a remote onboarding procedure based on eIDAS-qualified electronic signatures, high-resolution video verification, and notarised/apostilled copies of constitutional documents. Non-resident individual UBOs without EU eID are almost always demanded to appear physically at the bank or at an embassy/notary abroad. The SARL's registered office address must be verifiable via a Luxembourg domiciliation agreement, and the bank will conduct a Lands Registry/UBO register search.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient source of funds for initial capital subscriptions and shareholder loans from a foreign non-visible shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised or apostilled capital subscription deed including the subscribed EUR 12,000 minimum SARL share capital; bank reference letter from the contributing shareholder's home bank; audited or independent-accountant financial statements of the shareholder for the last two years; source-of-wealth statement signed by the UBO; detailed witness-copy explanation of accumulated earnings, trade sales, or inheritance; UBO register extracts confirming the ownership chain; tax residency certificates of the shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.mitigation_statement: The SARL will provide a board-approved treasury policy confirming that no share capital contribution is sourced from cryptocurrency for non-convertible assets, unlicensed lenders, or pooled gaming proceeds, and that all contributions are made directly from a regulated bank account in the name of the contributing shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency inbound micropayments from Apple App Store and Google Play without transparent platform reconciliation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Apple Developer Program and Google Play Developer account agreements; consolidated monthly payout statements showing net proceeds, country breakdown, tax withholding, and remittance of the SARL; internal reconciliation ledger mapping each payout to library transactions; VAT/OSS registration certificate if applicable; a description of the digital content monetisation model proving the economic substance and absence of layering or gambling proceeds; compliance confirmation that the platforms are not distributing content to embargoed countries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.mitigation_statement: The SARL will open a dedicated collection account, use the bank's e-banking API to reconcile daily transactions, and submit external accountant letters showing the payments are operating revenue from digital comic sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border digital licensing and royalty disbursements to independent artists in non-EU jurisdictions with weak AML oversight.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written licence and webtoon syndication contracts for each inflowing/outflowing intellectual property title; chain-of-title documentation from the original author or studio; invoice-based royalty schedules with net-of-tax calculations; artist KYC kits including passport copy, proof of bank account, and a signed guarantee of ownership; where a local paying agency is concerned, a sample of the agency's registration and beneficial-owner registry; tax and transfer-pricing documentation for royalty rates accepted by the Luxembourg tax administration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.mitigation_statement: The SARL will maintain a continuously updated central IP register, show the business rationale for physical print merchandise and film/series adaptations under ISIC 9000, and refuse all outbound payments to non-specified counterparties without senior treasury sign-off.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of physical economic substance in Luxembourg despite an official registered office, creating a negative signal under AML and tax-avoidance screens.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Luxembourg domiciliation agreement with a regulated service provider; employment contracts or service agreements for local managers, editors, accountants, or content moderators; lease of a virtual/administrative office if the business remains remote; minutes of board meetings held in Luxembourg or via online meeting with signatories; bank statements showing periodic payroll and corporate expenses paid from the Luxembourg account; Luxembourg VAT number and employer registration; a financial projection proving the SARL is not a shell.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.mitigation_statement: The SARL will designate the daily treasury and fulfilment functions (platform onboarding, tax returns, distribution of royalties) in Luxembourg and will appoint a Luxembourg-based compliance officer where required by the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and embargo concerns because digital content may be sold through app stores in territories subject to EU/UN sanctions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening policy aligned with CSSF guidance; a list of permitted distribution territories and storefront countries; contractual clauses requiring Apple/Google to withhold content from sanctioned/embargoed countries; the SARL's negative declaration that it is not a sanctioned person and is not controlled by sanctioned persons; UBO registry search results for each shareholder and director; periodic referral reports from treasury staff.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.mitigation_statement: The SARL will ensure each payment from the bank is initiated only after sanctions screening and will not accept proceeds that originated in, to, or through sanctioned jurisdictions unless expressly licensed by the competent authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The SARL's initial or subsequent share capital injection must be routed to a dedicated Luxembourg EUR account by SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) from a European shareholder, or by SWIFT MT103 from a non-European shareholder, using the beneficiary’s IBAN and the receiving bank’s BIC. The payment remittance message must contain a transparent reference: 'CAPITAL INCREASE – SHAREHOLDER CONTRIBUTION – [SARL RCS number]' and be accompanied by a copy of the notarized capital increase resolution, the shareholder register, an updated UBO declaration, and a source-of-funds statement. Luxembourg does not require prior exchange-control approval for inbound equity or debt contributions. If the inbound transfer is a subordinated shareholder loan, the loan agreement with interest rate and repayment schedule must be provided to the bank for AML and tax documentation. The bank will apply enhanced scrutiny where the contributing entity is domiciled in a non-EEA jurisdiction without adequate UBO transparency; the SARL must supply proof that the contribution is made from the shareholder’s own bank account and is not remitted through collective investment vehicles or nominee accounts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury disbursements for the webtoon publishing group will be executed over SEPA (for EU vendors and EU creators) and SWIFT MT103 (for non-EU licensors, artists, local subsidiaries, printers, or marketing service providers). Each MT103 must carry a purpose code relevant to digital content royalties, e.g., 'Royalty for syndicated digital comic licensing', 'Licence fee for localisation services', or 'Remuneration to independent author under work-for-hire contract'. Where physical ancillary print merchandise is purchased from the SARL, a Documentary Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) may be used with specified invoicing and bill-of-lading terms, but for digital intangible deliverables only invoice and electronic delivery certificates are necessary. The SARL treasury will require all outbound transfers to be covered by signed contracts, VAT invoices or pro-formas, and a beneficial-owner tax certificate where preferential withholding rates apply. Luxembourg does not restrict cash outflows, but the bank will impose AML review for payments to tax havens or jurisdictions with opaque corporate registers. Any dividend or IP royalty payment out of the SARL must be structured to satisfy Luxembourg withholding tax formalities, including use of an FX/treasury account maintained in the currency of the supplier to avoid unnecessary conversion costs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD, EUR/JPY, EUR/KRW and EUR/GBP forward contracts concluded with an EEA-registered credit institution or investment firm to hedge cash flows from app-store settlements and foreign-currency licence fees.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on emerging-market currencies such as INR, IDR, BRL, and MXN, where local unrelated non-deliverable FX markets make a fully deliverable hedge impossible; NDFs may be used only when the underlying cash flow is a foreign-currency platform receipt in an actively restricted currency.

Cross-currency swaps converting a long-term USD or KRW revenue stream into EUR for treasury cash-flow smoothing; local Luxembourg law does not prohibit SARL treasury swaps beyond MiFID capacity, but transactions must be contracted under an ISDA/CMA agreement with an authorised EU counterparty.
Vanilla FX options purchased as premium-only to cap adverse currency moves on known upcoming platform remittances; sale of options is excluded to avoid speculative risk.

FX swap structures for temporary EUR/foreign-currency liquidity imbalances during app-store payout cycles, subject to the SARL's own treasury risk policy and EMIR reporting obligations for non-financial counterparties above clearing thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.treasury_liquidity_policy: The SARL will maintain three distinct accounts at a tier-1 Luxembourg bank: an Operating Account for payroll, local taxes, and recurring EU expenses; a Collection Account interfacing with Apple/Google settlement statements; and a Reserve/Trade Disbursement Account holding up to 30 days of forecast royalty obligations. Inbound platform funds will be swept daily from the Collection Account to the Operating Account for concentration. OCR/payment-reconciliation software will map Google Play and Apple IAP reports to the bank's MT940/MT942 statements. FX exposure is netted on a weekly basis and only economic purchase/sale transactions are hedged. The treasury manager will require two-signatory authorisation for any disbursement exceeding EUR 10,000 and strict third-party beneficiary verification on SWIFT payments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (balance sheet, profit and loss account and annexes) filed and published in the electronic compendium (RESA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the annual general meeting; the general meeting must approve within six months of financial year-end, giving an outer filing deadline of seven months after financial year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Continued non-filing after formal notice may trigger coercive fines by the commercial court; persistent default can lead to judicial winding-up and administrative strike-off from the RCS, with personal liability exposure for managers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual combined corporate income tax and net wealth tax return (Model 1002), including municipal business tax data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 December of the year following the relevant financial year for calendar-year taxpayers; non-calendar-year filers file by the same relative deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may incur administrative fines (generally EUR 5–EUR 250 per return), an estimated or ex-officio assessment, late-payment interest on assessed tax, and, in serious cases, a 10% increase in the tax due; register strike-off is not directly triggered by tax default but by annual accounts non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation (RBE filing) or updated beneficial-owner declaration on any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 15 December (administratively set calendar-year deadline); any change in beneficial ownership must be declared within one month of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm or update the RBE declaration is a criminal contravention under the law of 13 January 2019, subject to fines against the entity and managers; continued non-confirmation may flag the company as non-compliant in the RBE and impede certain registered corporate acts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Luxembourg SARL is subject to mandatory statutory audit by an approved statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) when it exceeds more than one of the following thresholds at the balance-sheet date: balance-sheet total above EUR 4.4 million, net turnover above EUR 8.8 million, and average number of employees above 50; audit may also be required by the articles of association, shareholder request, parent-company requirements, or public-interest status.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 19 December 2002 on commercial companies and the applicable EU Accounting Directive regime; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted for individual annual accounts and generally required for consolidated accounts of certain public-interest and listed parent entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must annually confirm to the Luxembourg Business Registers that the beneficial-owner information shown in the RBE remains accurate and complete. The confirmation is due by the annual RBE deadline (15 December in administrative practice). If a share transfer or beneficial-ownership change has occurred, the entity must file a full updated RBE declaration instead of a simple confirmation, within one month of the change. The manager or registered agent performs this filing electronically; the RBE record is periodically cross-checked against the share register.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Exempt for a typical small SARL below audit thresholds; if a statutory audit becomes compulsory, representative certified audit fees for a small SARL range from USD 5,000 to USD 12,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (combined: 17% CIT + 7% solidarity surcharge on CIT + 6.75% municipal business tax in Luxembourg City)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP box 80% exemption on qualifying IP income (nexus-compliant); participation exemption for qualifying dividends/capital gains (≥10% shareholding or ≥EUR 1.2m cost, 12-month holding); R&D tax credit (20% on eligible expenses for new investments, 25% for incremental R&D, subject to caps); net wealth tax exemption for qualifying participations.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory time limit; annual offset restricted to 70% of taxable income exceeding EUR 1,000,000)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1 (Corporate Income Tax / 'Impôt sur le revenu des collectivités') filed electronically via the Luxembourg e-Tax portal on MyGuichet / Guichet.lu
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: By 31 May following the calendar tax year-end (or within 5 months after the financial year-end for non-calendar fiscal years)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: legal name, RCS number, registered seat, tax ID (n° national de matricule).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident with Luxembourg PE: provide PE address and permanent agent details in Box 4.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax accounting period (begin and end dates) and currency of account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the PE's accounting period; if the PE's records are in foreign currency, report in EUR with audited translation notes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable profit or loss after deducting allowable expenses and prior-year losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only net income attributable to the Luxembourg PE from webtoon licensing/subscription activities may be reported.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Qualifying IP income deduction (IP box): 80% exemption on net income from qualifying copyrights/patents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply only where the IP is economically owned, developed, and managed by the Luxembourg PE; attach nexus ratios and income tracking by title.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a default assessment, progressive fines up to EUR 25,000, a 10% surcharge on the tax due, and monthly late-payment interest of 0.6%. Directors in personal default may be held joint-severally liable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form TCC (Municipal Business Tax Return / 'Taxe commerciale communale') through the same Luxembourg e-Tax portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same deadline as Form 1 (31 May / 5-month rule)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Municipal business taxable base: net income adjusted per municipal tax law before the municipal tax multiplier.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a PE, apportion the municipal tax base among municipalities where the PE is established based on payroll and fixed assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file imposes the same late-filing penalties as CIT and municipal authorities may enforce payment through distraint and administrative recovery.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IF (Net Wealth Tax Return / 'Impôt sur la fortune') filed with the same e-Tax portal

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net wealth tax base: total worldwide net assets for resident SARL, including shareholdings, bank deposits, receivables, after eligible liabilities and exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities with a Luxembourg PE report only active assets connected with the PE; foreign assets are excluded.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file exposes the entity to an automatic 0.5% per quarter penalty on the net wealth tax due, plus interest at 0.6% per month.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% (domestic statutory rate; may be reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive when holding ≥10% for at least 12 months, or reduced to 5-15% under applicable DTA)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, beneficial owner must file a withholding tax exemption/refund application with the Luxembourg tax authorities (Administration des contributions directes) using Form 2 (or electronic application via eTax), accompanied by valid tax residence certificate (TRC) from the recipient's jurisdiction, beneficial ownership declaration, and underlying shareholding documentation. For dividends qualifying under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive, Form 2M or Form 2bis may be required; advance rulings for structural certainty should be submitted before distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% domestic withholding on outbound royalties except payments to non-cooperative/blacklisted jurisdictions (15% in abuse cases); DTA rates generally 0-10%. Interest: 0% standard domestic withholding, with no WHT on interest paid to unrelated non-residents; anti-hybrid and CFC rules may impose adjustments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 50,000,000 (annual net turnover of Luxembourg entity triggers Master File and Local File obligation); CbC Report mandatory for MNE groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750,000,000
